title: Outcome manifest — one committed round (server-authoritative contract)
description: The complete, immutable record of one round: identity and versioning, wager, initial grid, the ordered presentation steps, feature block, totals, and signature. The client is a pure renderer of this manifest: skipping/turbo/autoplay never change any value in it. Recovery = re-fetch this committed manifest plus resumePointer and seek presentation to that step instantly. stepIds are strictly ordered step-1, step-2, … (ordering and cross-field sums are enforced by the runtime validator; JSON Schema cannot express them).
x-extensions: Forward compatibility: unknown top-level fields are rejected (additionalProperties false). Extensions MUST go under the 'ext' property, namespaced as '<vendor>.<key>'. Validators must ignore ext content they do not understand and the signature always covers it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest schema the round was produced against.

roundId.description: Globally unique round id issued by the RGS (dev provider uses the same format).

gameId.description: Stable machine id of the game (kebab-case), matching config/game-config.json.

gameVersion.description: Semver of the game package that produced this round.

mathVersion.description: Semver of the math model that produced this round.

mathProfileId.description: Which RTP profile was active, e.g. 'rtp-96'.

configHash.description: sha256 of the canonical config/*.json concatenation active for this round (CONVENTIONS §5).

wagerMinor.description: Total bet for this round in integer minor units.

initialBalanceMinor.description: Optional: player balance in minor units before the wager was taken.

initialGrid.description: The grid as first presented, columns-major: outer array = reels left to right, inner arrays = symbol ids top to bottom.

steps.description: Ordered presentation steps of the base round. stepIds ascend strictly (step-1, step-2, …) across the whole manifest including feature.steps.

feature.description: Feature block. When triggered is true, all tier fields are required and feature rounds live in feature.steps.

triggered.description: Whether this round triggered any feature tier.

remainingRounds.description: Rounds still unplayed at the point this manifest describes (0 when the feature finished; >0 only mid-recovery).

steps.description: Ordered steps of the feature, continuing the manifest-wide stepId sequence.

retriggers.description: Number of retriggers that occurred (bounded by the retrigger cap).

maxWinReached.description: Whether the feature ended by max-win termination.

totalWinMinor.description: Total win of the whole round (base + feature) in integer minor units, after max-win capping. Must equal the sum of all step winMinor values as capped (runtime-validated).

maximumWinReached.description: Whether the round hit the max-win cap (a max_win_termination step must then be present).

balanceAfterMinor.description: Optional: player balance in minor units after settlement.

roundComplete.description: Whether the round is fully settled server-side. Always true for committed manifests; false only in transitional recovery payloads.

resumePointer.description: Optional: the step at which an interrupted presentation must resume. Present only in recovery payloads.

signature.description: Detached JWS (or HMAC placeholder in dev) over the canonical manifest bytes minus this signature field itself.

ext.description: Namespaced forward-compatibility extensions. Keys are '<vendor>.<key>' (lowercase vendor prefix, dot, camelCase key); values are any JSON. Unknown entries must be ignored by consumers.

minorUnits.description: Money as integer minor units (cents). Never floats for settlement.

stepId.description: Step identifier step-<n>, n starting at 1 and strictly ascending in manifest order.

eventId.description: Presentation hint id: an animation, audio, or haptic event id per CONVENTIONS §4.3.

grid.description: Columns-major grid: outer array = reels left to right; inner arrays = symbol ids top to bottom. Rows per reel may vary (expanding grids).

items.description: One reel's visible symbols, top to bottom.

position.description: Grid position as [column, row], zero-based, columns-major.

prefixItems.description: Zero-based row index from the top.

win.description: One winning combination in a step. Exactly one of lineId / waysCount / clusterSize may be present, matching the game's win-evaluation mode.

symbolId.description: The paying symbol (wilds report the substituted symbol).

positions.description: Grid positions [column, row] that form this win.

payX100.description: Pay as integer hundredths of a bet (250 = 2.5x), before applying winMinor floor rule.

winMinor.description: Settled amount for this win: (betMinor * payX100) // 100, floor, including any step multiplier already applied per the math model.

waysCount.description: Number of ways this symbol combination pays (ways games only).

step.description: One atomic presentation step. The client renders steps in order; every value is server-committed.

stepId.description: Strictly ascending step id within the manifest.

grid.description: Grid state at the end of this step, columns-major.

wins.description: Wins evaluated in this step (empty for non-paying steps).

scatterCount.description: Scatters counting toward a trigger at the end of this step, per the configured counting rule.

multiplier100.description: Win multiplier active in this step, x100 fixed point (100 = 1x).

events.description: Presentation hint ids (animation/audio/haptic) the client plays for this step. Hints only: they never carry outcome data.
